# BAD-064 — collab says the wrong thing twice: join answers one reason with two status codes, and upload-url calls a missing byte count too_large

## Brief
Merged from BAD-064 and BAD-065 (2026-09-16 triage): the same defect twice, in the same file, pinned by the same test file — collab answering with a status or a code that does not describe what happened. Settle both deliberately rather than inheriting either through a split. Verified on main e9f8709.

**1. Join answers one reason with two status codes (was BAD-064).** A join code that does not normalize (`normalizeJoinCode` returns null) answers 404 `{allowed:false, reason:'unknown_code'}` — `lobby.ts:82`. A code that normalizes fine but names no room falls through to `decideJoin` and answers 403 with the SAME body (`_shared/collab.mjs:394,416`). Same word, two statuses, decided by a detail the person typing has no way to see. Clients branch on `data.code || data.error` and on the join shape's `reason`, so nothing is broken today, but any client or proxy keying on status treats one typo as "not found" and the next as "forbidden". Both are pinned in `test/server/functions.test.mjs`, "collab: join names an unknown code two ways, and a rejoin is the same seat": 'not a code' -> 404, 'BT-ZZZZZZ' -> 403, identical bodies — so the test moves with the decision.

**2. `upload-url` reports a missing or zero byte count as `*_too_large` (was BAD-065).** The size check is one expression — `Number.isFinite(bytes) && bytes > 0 && bytes <= MAX` — and every way of failing it answers the same code: `bytes:0`, `bytes:-1`, `bytes:'lots'` and a body with no `bytes` at all all come back 413 `{code:'thumb_too_large'|'scene_too_large'|'take_too_large'|'cam_too_large', max}`. A client told "too large" for a value that is nothing of the kind will show the wrong copy and may retry by shrinking something that was never the problem. A distinct 400 `bad_bytes` for the not-a-positive-number half would cost one branch per kind and say what actually happened. Sites: `push.ts:69` (thumb), `:83` (scene), `:95` (take), `:104` (cam). Pinned in `test/server/functions.test.mjs`, "collab: upload-url refuses before it ever signs": bytes of 0, -1, 'lots' and null all answer 413 `thumb_too_large` against a local stack.

Both are client-visible contract changes, so they want one decision and one migration of the pinning tests. `server-deploy.yml` deploys on merge; the `Server integration` CI check is authoritative for the suite.
